input: Same archived AAL90 FC matrices; BrainNetCNN uses the same per-subject LayerNorm as the ABIDE rerun.
protocol: Five fixed diagnosis-stratified mixed-site random holdouts: 679 training / 86 development / 82 test; same subjects as the ADHD EN75 parameter study. Not five-fold cross-validation.
checkpoint_selection: Prespecified final epoch: BrainGNN 100, BrainGB 100, BrainNetTF 200, BrainNetCNN 50.

BrainGNN: PyG 2.5 MessagePassing in place of legacy custom propagation; mathematical mean aggregation retained
TopKPooling.select.weight API replacement; author double sigmoid retained
Input 90 FC features and 90 positional identities; graph abs archived FC without loops, explicitly an FC-input adaptation
BrainGB: Unchanged official GCN module; node_concate + concat selected in historical manuscript; AAL90 input
BrainNetworkTransformer: Attention heads 4 -> 2 because AAL90 feature width is not divisible by 4
Pooling 100/200 -> 45/90, preserving ABIDE one-half ROI ratio
PyTorch 2.2 is_causal support and keyword constructor to preserve default bias=True across library versions; model/loss otherwise retained

context: Exploratory comparison on the five ADHD partitions whose BrainKAN results have already been inspected. Every model uses all five partitions; no partition or model is selected by test performance.

pending_models.FBNetGen: Requires FC-matched ADHD regional time series.
pending_models.BrainNetGNN: Requires FC-matched ADHD regional time series.
